title: 5D typed Statement
description: A typed-statement node (spec/SPEC.md §21, typed-triple layer). Mirrors five_d_nd/statement.py's statement_violations() exactly: 'id' is the stable instrument URI + consolidation date + a 16-hex-digit lowercase sha256 text hash, enforced to this schema's own 'id' pattern; 'subj'/'obj' are unit or entity ids; 'predicate' is one of §21's closed, versioned v3 enum; 'dimension' is one of the five (§2) and MUST agree with the predicate's own fixed dimension (checked by code, not expressible in this schema alone — see the per-predicate 'dimension' table in vocabulary/statement-predicates.json); 'layer' is one of surface/domain/deep, computed from the clause's own text position and function, independent of 'predicate'; 'weight' is in [0,1], defaulting to 1.0 when absent (schema does not apply the default, only the type); 'edge_confidence' is REQUIRED and SEPARATE from weight; 'provenance' is a span {start,end} with start >= 0 and 0 <= start < end; 'negation' reuses §18's three-state present/uncertain/absent; 'extraction_rule_id' is OPTIONAL, non-empty string or null (null is the gold convention). additionalProperties is false: an unknown field is a schema rejection, never silently ignored. This schema is, per §9's P1-P3 policy pattern, intentionally STRICTER than code on a malformed shape only (e.g. provenance.start/end as non-integers, or an id not matching the pinned shape) and MUST accept every well-formed document the code accepts.
